<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Invalid credentials</span></div>

## Why it happens

The e-mail address is not a SENTIENT user, or the password is wrong. For security the message does not say which. Every wrong password counts toward the account lockout ([ST-AUTH-003](/docs/troubleshooting/errors/st-auth-003/)).

## Fix it

- Check the e-mail address, and that Caps Lock is off.
- Use **Forgot password?** on the login page to get a reset link by e-mail. This needs a working [mail server](/docs/user-guide/ui/mail-settings/).
- An administrator can open the user and use **Resend activation** or set up the account again.

## Check that it worked

Sign-in opens the Home page.
